parsed.why: No trans-specific offence or documented visitor targeting, but state erasure architecture (LGR ban, sex redefined) and official demonisation signal hostile institutions; document-screening mismatch is an open question, not a documented exposure. Resident-facing gaps not deducted.

Documented traveller-facing exposure: X markers halted, officers told to refuse sex-discrepancy cases, foreign citizens detained, allied travel advisories; facility bans in ~21 states, some criminal; custody abuse. Courts and hate-crime law only partially offset.

No trans criminal offence and an embedded third-gender tradition, but documented police friction: airport stop despite ID, groping 'gender checks', degrading custody, lost criminal-code protections. Below acceptance-with-working-protections tier; recourse partial.

Border accepts X and foreign markers with no extra documents; bathroom access protected; discrimination and hate-motive law in force. Undercut by ungoverned birth-sex custody placement with documented harm, rising reports, near-zero convictions.

Article 521 jails trans feminine presentation up to six years; morality article still enforced with arrests and forced anal exams; gathering ban; rising violence. Courts reluctant but statutes unrepealed — structural criminalisation resolves low.
